# MrW Overlay for POE 2 v2.16.2

## Fixes

- **Loot filter prices:** currency that rarely trades on the in-game Currency Exchange is no longer priced on one or two trades. When an item saw too few trades in the last six hours, its price now comes from the last day's trades against Exalted Orbs, and only when no such trades exist does another price list fill in. Some thinly traded essences, runes and soul cores had been shown as worth a Divine Orb or more.
- **When the shared prices are late:** shared prices count as current for six hours. Past that, the app works out its own prices, the in-game Currency Exchange included, and only falls back to the last prices it has when it cannot.

MrW Overlay is built by a player, for players. It is not an official Grinding Gear Games product, and they don't back it.

## Updating

On v1.8.0 or later, update from Settings → **Updates**. Your filter settings, profiles, saved searches and pathofexile.com connection are kept. The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.

## Install

The release file is `poe2filtre-windows-amd64.exe`. It is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you: **More info → Run anyway**. Or get it from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PM376D3LFBG
